title: EasyJet agrees to £5.7bn takeover
title_zh: 易捷航空同意以 57 亿英镑收购
summary: EasyJet has agreed to a deal to sell the airline for around £5.7bn ($7.7bn) to a US-based investment firm.
summary_zh: EasyJet 已同意达成协议，以约 57 亿英镑（77 亿美元）的价格将该航空公司出售给一家美国投资公司。

title: Budget carrier easyJet confirms €6.6 billion takeover by US private equity firm
title_zh: 廉价航空公司易捷航空确认被美国私募股权公司以 66 亿欧元收购
summary: EasyJet was founded by British-Cypriot entrepreneur Stelios Haji-Ioannou in 1995 as a no-frills airline offering low-cost fares to destinations across Europe.View on euronews
summary_zh: EasyJet 由英籍塞浦路斯企业家 Stelios Haji-Ioannou 于 1995 年创立，是一家提供飞往欧洲各地的廉价机票的廉价航空公司。

title: Apollo Agrees to $7.7 Billion Deal for Britain’s easyJet
title_zh: 阿波罗同意以 77 亿美元收购英国易捷航空
summary: Apollo Global Management looks set to take to the skies. The private-equity group on Thursday agreed a deal to buy British budget airline easyJet for the equivalent of roughly $7.7 billion, prevailing in a weekslong bidding war with fellow American investor Castlelake.
summary_zh: 阿波罗全球管理公司看起来即将飞向天空。该私募股权集团周四同意以约 77 亿美元的价格收购英国廉价航空公司易捷航空 (easyJet)，并在与美国投资者 Castlelake 长达一周的竞购战中获胜。
